description: The WITH KEY phrase of the ENABLE and DISABLE statements, the password the COBOL-85 communication module prints (CCVS-85 CM101M, CM102M, CM201M write it; CM303M flags it as obsolete there). ISO/IEC 1989:2002 A.2.2.1 and A.2.3.1 print neither statement with it, and Table A.1 has no status 40 for an invalid key. The 1985 text is not held: CCVS-85 is the witness of its presence, the 2002 general formats of its removal. kb/Work PB4677.
display: the KEY phrase of the ENABLE and DISABLE statements
citation: ISO/IEC 1989:2002 A.2.2.1, A.2.3.1 (no KEY phrase); §1985:XIV.3.2.4 GR7, §1985:XIV.3.3.4 GR6 (the password, REMOVED); CCVS-85 CM303M (obsolete at 85); VCR Table 7

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. CDK.
DATA DIVISION.
COMMUNICATION SECTION.

PROCEDURE DIVISION.

    STOP RUN.
